result.instructions: Tools for DoorLoop, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tenants have an outstanding balance above $500, and on which leases?"; "List all leases that end in the next 60 days."; "Show open work orders for our Maple Street property.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DoorLoop data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run doorloop_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run doorloop_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run doorloop_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. doorloop_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: doorloop_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task in DoorLoop. INTERNAL_TASK needs requested_by_user, TENANT_REQUEST needs requested_by_tenant, OWNER_REQUEST needs requested_by_owner, WORK_ORDER needs assigned_to_vendor. Notifications are off unless you set them. Each call creates a new task. DoorLoop API: POST /tasks.

notify_tenant.description: Notify the tenant (TENANT_REQUEST only). Default: no.

notify_assignees.description: Notify the assigned users. Default: no.

tools.name: doorloop_post_task_update
tools.title: Post an update on a task
tools.description: WRITE: post a message on an existing task and optionally change its status, priority, due date or assignees. Each call adds a new update. Notifications are off unless you set them. DoorLoop API: POST /tasks/update.

notify_assignees.description: Notify the assigned users. Default: no.

annotations.title: Post an update on a task
